Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Cameron Johnson?

Cameron Johnson is 30 years old.

Where was Cameron Johnson born?

Cameron Johnson was born in Moon Township, Pennsylvania.

When was Cameron Johnson born?

Cameron Johnson was born on March 3, 1996.

How tall is Cameron Johnson?

Cameron Johnson is 6-8 (203 cm) tall.

How much does Cameron Johnson weigh?

Cameron Johnson weighs 210 lbs (95 kg).

Is Cameron Johnson in the Hall of Fame?

Cameron Johnson is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Cameron Johnson drafted?

Cameron Johnson was drafted by Minnesota Timberwolves, 1st round (11th pick, 11th overall), 2019 NBA Draft.

What position does Cameron Johnson play?

Power Forward and Small Forward.

What is Cameron Johnson's net worth?

Cameron Johnson has made at least $87,829,912 playing professional basketball.

How much does Cameron Johnson make?

Cameron Johnson made $25,679,348 in 2024.

How many rings does Cameron Johnson have?

Cameron Johnson has won 0 championships.

What is Cameron Johnson's Instagram account?

Cameron Johnson is on Instagram at camjohnson23.

What schools did Cameron Johnson attend?

Cameron Johnson attended Our Lady of the Sacred Heart in Coraopolis, Pennsylvania, Pitt and UNC.

What are Cameron Johnson's nicknames?

Cam is a nickname for Cameron Johnson.
